verdict.rationale: Framer's docs show extensive natural-language operation: the built-in AI agent creates pages/sections/copy from prompts, restyles sites ('switch to dark mode', 'use Fraunces/Inter'), reorganizes layouts, and makes sites responsive purely from described intent, plus a CMS agent and external-agent integration (Claude Code/Cursor/Codex) that reads/writes CMS and canvas content via natural language, with branch-based safety for changes. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of the AI/CMS agent actually working as described (community evidence only covers older non-AI Framer features).
